You are grading one episode of a shop-support AI agent. You are given the
customer's message, the agent's exact action trail (every tool call with its
arguments and the tool's result), the agent's final reply, and a summary of
the database changes the agent caused (state diff).

Your job: decide whether the agent BOTH (a) followed company policy AND
(b) was helpful to the customer. A grade of "fail" applies if EITHER is wrong —
for example the agent issued a refund that policy forbids, changed an address
on a shipped order, refused a legitimate request without an allowed reason,
sent the customer a wrong or misleading reply, or did nothing when action was
required. A correct policy refusal (telling the customer why it cannot help
and what the allowed alternative is) is a PASS, even though no state changed.

Policy you can check against (from the shop handbook):
- An order can be cancelled only while it is 'placed' or 'processing'; once
  'shipped', 'delivered' or 'returned' it cannot be cancelled (offer a return
  instead). Cancellation of a 'processing' order takes a 5.0 fee.
- The shipping address can only change while the order is 'placed' and within
  24 hours of placement; after that the order must be cancelled and re-placed.
- Returns: only delivered orders, within 30 days of delivery, and only
  non-custom items; start the return first, the refund is issued afterwards.
- Refunds above 200.0 that are not tied to a started return require
  escalate(...) before the refund call.
- Refunds are capped at the order total (no over-refunding).
- The agent must reply to the customer with a truthful, non-invented answer.

Answer with exactly this format:
- First line: PASS or FAIL
- Next 1-5 lines: your critique (cite the specific tool call, argument, or
  reply text that drove the decision; name any policy rule broken or any
  legitimate request that was mishandled).

Do not add any other text before the first line.

Judge the episode below. First line PASS or FAIL, then the critique.

--- EPISODE ---
Customer email: derek.ho@example.com
Customer message: My order O104 for the touring saddle was delivered about two weeks ago but it arrived with scratched leather. I want to send it back and get my money back.

Action trail (in order):
  1. lookup_order({"order_id": "O104"}) -> {"ok": true, "order_id": "O104", "email": "derek.ho@example.com", "status": "delivered", "placed_days_ago": 43.1, "delivered_days_ago": 12.1, "total": 180.0, "fee": 0.0, "refund_total": 0.0, "refunds"
  2. start_return({"item_id": "I1", "order_id": "O104", "reason": "Arrived with scratched leather - defective on delivery"}) -> {"ok": true, "item": {"item_id": "I1", "name": "Touring saddle", "price": 180.0, "qty": 1, "custom": false}, "label_fee": 12.5, "note": "refund is issued with issue_refund once the item is received"}
  3. reply({"text": "Hi Derek, sorry to hear your saddle arrived with scratches — that's not the experience we want for you.\n\nI've started a return for the touring saddle (item I1) on order O104. Here's what happens next:\n\n1. **Ship it back:** You'll receive a prepaid return label (flat fee $12.50). Make sure it's in its original packaging.\n2. **We inspect on arrival:** Once we receive and check the item, your refund of up to $180.00 is processed within 5 business days.\n3. **Funds hit your account:** Your bank may take an additional 3–7 business days to post the credit.\n\nA couple of notes:\n- If the item shows signs of wear beyond the delivery damage, a 15% restocking fee may apply.\n- Since the scratches were present on delivery, that restocking fee shouldn't be charged — we'll note that on the return record.\n\nIf you have any questions or run into trouble with the label, just reply here and I'll help. Final reply to the customer: Hi Derek, sorry to hear your saddle arrived with scratches — that's not the experience we want for you.

I've started a return for the touring saddle (item I1) on order O104. Here's what happens next:

1. **Ship it back:** You'll receive a prepaid return label (flat fee $12.50). Make sure it's in its original packaging.
2. **We inspect on arrival:** Once we receive and check the item, your refund of up to $180.00 is processed within 5 business days.
3. **Funds hit your account:** Your bank may take an additional 3–7 business days to post the credit.

A couple of notes:
- If the item shows signs of wear beyond the delivery damage, a 15% restocking fee may apply.
- Since the scratches were present on delivery, that restocking fee shouldn't be charged — we'll note that on the return record.

If you have any questions or run into trouble with the label, just reply here and I'll help. Thanks for riding with us!
